title: Aktenablage: Option, grosse Dokumente zu loeschen
cause: No such feature. Archiving a case (chkArchived in ArchiveFilePanel) never looks at document sizes, a new suggestion dialog listing large images/videos/documents with delete actions would be needed.
maintainer: Raw idea by j-dimension himself (2026-10-29), no details.
notes: Thresholds, file types, recycle bin vs hard delete and when to show the dialog are all undecided. New dialog, not a small PR.

title: Switch JDBC connections to caching_sha2_password (MySQL 8.4/9)
cause: Backup manager JDBC URL uses sslMode=DISABLED without allowPublicKeyRetrieval, which fails for caching_sha2_password users on first login. Server datasources live in installer/Docker standalone.xml (Docker uses the MariaDB driver). Connector is 8.2.0
maintainer: Own task list (2026-10-28): decide and document TLS vs public key retrieval, update datasources, installer scripts, migration notes, test MySQL 8.0/8.4/MariaDB
notes: Maintainer epic opened two days ago, decision pending and most work is in installers outside this repo. The backupmgr URL part could become a small PR once he picks the approach

title: Aktenanlage: Vorbelegung Sachbearbeiter / Anwalt konfigurierbar
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.clearInputs() hard-codes the presets for a new case: lawyer = current user (only if isLawyer()), assistant = current user. There is no configurable default like the per-user primaryGroup preset for group and authorized groups.
maintainer: Should be configurable, analogous to the existing per-user preset of group and authorized groups.
notes: Config location (user admin vs own profile) and storage (UserSettings key-value store, no schema change, vs new AppUserBean column) are not decided. Small once that is settled.

title: Spalten Akten-/Adresssuche konfigurierbar (inkl. Eigene Felder)
cause: Both search panels build fixed colNames arrays (e.g. QuickArchiveFileSearchPanel line ~742) and fixed table models. The table model is shared with other panels (ArchiveFileReviewsMissingPanel). custom1-3 exist on ArchiveFileBean/AddressBean but are not shown.
notes: Column chooser + per-user persistence + custom fields in two search panels, modelled on the configurable document table from 5bbc007de. Large new UI feature, not one small PR.

title: Windows 11: invisible dialogs pile up behind the main window
cause: Not located. Maintainer suspects the per-document name prompts of copyOrMoveDocumentsToOtherCase (FileUtils.getNewFileName, see #3345), reporter denies copying. ReminderNotificationDialog is a reused singleton, so it is not the culprit
maintainer: Cannot reproduce despite daily 10h use, asks for the sequence of actions that creates the windows
notes: No repro steps, Windows 11 specific window ordering. Reporter later says they are dialogs that accumulate during the day. Possible relation to #3345

title: Dropscan: mehrere Scans als 1 PDF herunterladen
cause: The Dropscan tab in ScannerPanel imports one mailing at a time through DropscanEntryProcessor, there is no multi-select merge. PDFBox PDFMergerUtility is already used in EpostPdfMergeStep and ExportAsPdfMergeStep.
maintainer: Merge on the client side (Dropscan web UI reportedly has such a function).
notes: The merge itself is easy, but verifying needs a live Dropscan account and API downloads. Order of pages and destroy-after-import for the merged mailings also need a decision.

title: beAstie: Anzeigename statt Dateiname bei Anzeige und lokalem Speichern
cause: Regression from beAstie migration e43b2b0e8: BeaAttachment.toString() returns only the alias, the old wrapper Attachment.toString() returned "(alias) fileName" (verified with javap on j-lawyer-proprietary/libs/j-lawyer-bea-wrapper.jar). AttachmentListCellRenderer and BeaMessageContentUI.mnuSaveAsFile/mnuSearchSave use toString() as list text and default file name, so the extension is lost. The cancel error is an NPE in BeaMessageContentUI.mnuSearchSaveActionPerformed: FileUtils.preserveExtension(att.getName(), newName) is called before the null check when getNewFileName() returns null (introduced by 72e71b7ab).
notes: Two small topics, best as two PRs: (1) restore "(alias) name" in BeaAttachment.toString (unit-testable), (2) null check before preserveExtension on cancel (trivially reviewable). The wish to use "(alias) name" also in the bulk save of a whole message (BeaInboxPanel uses att.getName()) and the long-term unique-id idea are enhancements, keep out of scope. Related to #1743 (aliases now shown again).

title: Dateinamen beim Kopieren/Verschieben von Dokumenten beibehalten
cause: ArchiveFilePanel.copyOrMoveDocumentsToOtherCase() calls FileUtils.getNewFileName() once per selected document with applyNameTemplate=move, so every document gets a dialog and a move also applies the name template. The server copyDocumentsToCase/moveDocumentsToCase already falls back to the source name when no new name is given.
notes: Client-only change in one method: for a multi-selection ask once whether to keep the existing names, skip the per-document dialog and template, and fall back to the dialog only on a name clash (doesDocumentExist), since addDocumentImpl throws on duplicates. UI pattern (one upfront question vs a 'fuer alle' option) should be confirmed with j-dimension. Not endorsed by the maintainer yet.

title: beA: Weiterleitung ohne XJustiz-Strukturdatensatz
cause: Hypothesis: BeaInboxPanel.cmdForwardActionPerformed copies every entry of msg.getAttachments() as a plain attachment, including the original xjustiz_nachricht.xml and other technical attachments, so beAstie (which generates the outgoing SDS, not our code) probably sees an existing xjustiz_nachricht.xml and skips or replaces its own SDS.
maintainer: Issue filed by j-dimension himself.
notes: SDS generation happens inside the external beAstie service, so the effect of skipping technical attachments on forward can only be verified against a live beA/beAstie. Candidate fix is small (skip isTechnicalAttachment / xjustiz_nachricht.xml in the forward loop).

title: beAstie: Papierkorb leeren funktioniert nicht
cause: BeaAccess.deleteMessage() and BeaAccess.moveMessageToTrash() are identical, both call BeaService.deleteMessage() -> DELETE /api/v1/postboxes/{safeId}/messages/{id}, which in beAstie moves to trash. For a message already in the trash BRAK answers 0119 already in trash. No permanent-delete call exists. In cmdDeleteActionPerformed the per-message Throwable is only logged, so deleting single messages in the trash silently does nothing.
notes: Needs a permanent-delete endpoint in the external beAstie service (not in this repo, unknown whether it exists) plus server and client plumbing, verification only with live beA. The silent swallowing of errors in cmdDelete could be a tiny separate fix but does not solve the issue.

title: beAstie: in der Akte gespeicherte eEB-Abgabe nicht lesbar
cause: Not located. The eEB is stored by BeaMessageContentUI.saveEebResponse() as a .bea export of the BeaMessage returned by beAstie (/eeb/confirm). If that response carries attachments without content, opening it later depends on ensureAttachmentContent() reloading from the postbox. For an outgoing eEB (zuruecklaufend) cmdEebShow only renders getEebAsHtml(null, xml), which is the #917 limitation.
notes: The screenshot content is unknown, need the error text and ideally the stored .bea file to reproduce offline. Possibly overlaps #917 (eEB response rendered without the request pair). Side finding: cmdEebShow decodes the SDS with new String(data) using the platform charset (cp1252 on Windows with Java 17).

title: beAstie: Absender / Empfaenger nur noch mit Nachname
cause: BeaService.parseMessage()/parseMessageHeader() take senderName and recipients[].name verbatim from the beAstie JSON and BeaMessageContentUI.setMessageImpl() displays them unchanged, so the short name is produced by the external beAstie service, not by j-lawyer code.
maintainer: j-dimension: update the beAstie Docker image, the missing Unser Zeichen has been fixed there for a while.
notes: Reporter asks whether only the Unser Zeichen part was fixed. Needs a check against a current beAstie image. A fix (if still needed) belongs in beAstie, not in this repo.

title: beAstie: Fehlermeldung beim Verschieben in den Papierkorb
cause: BeaInboxPanel.drop() always calls BeaAccess.moveMessageToFolder() (PUT .../move), also when the target BeaFolder has type TRASH, BRAK rejects a move into the trash and only accepts delete. Fix: if BeaFolder.TYPE_TRASH equals target.getType() call bea.moveMessageToTrash(source.getSafeId(), m) instead.
maintainer: j-dimension: the BRAK API distinguishes move-to-folder from delete (move to trash), the UI must handle it separately, he wanted to look at it.
notes: Cause confirmed by maintainer, fix is a few lines and reuses the moveMessageToTrash path that already works via the trash button, so it is reviewable without live beA. Moving out of the trash via drag and drop (restore) is a separate question. Check with j-dimension first since he said he would look at it. Related to #3396.

title: Ingo chat: final answer shown above the tool call notices
cause: AssistantChatPanel.startBackgroundTask adds the placeholder incomingMsgPanel right after the user message, then appends the ToolCallGroupPanel with pnlMessages.add(activeToolGroup) below it and finally writes the answer into incomingMsgPanel, so the answer sits above the tools. Fix by inserting the group at the z-order index of incomingMsgPanel (or moving the panel below the group)
notes: Still present after 9fe6fb8e0 (2026-10-30, grouped and collapsible tool calls), which kept the append order. Reopened stored chats (AiChatTranscript.toEntries) already show tools before the answer, so only the live view is inconsistent. Maintainer is actively working in this file, coordinate to avoid conflicts

title: Falldaten (FDB) optional durchsuchbar machen
cause: ArchiveFileService.searchEnhanced() only matches name, fileNumber, filenumberext, reason, custom1-3, subjectField, lawyer, assistant and tags, form plugin data (case_forms entries) is not searched.
maintainer: Implementation unclear, maybe a switch in the case search to include form data.
notes: Maintainer explicitly says the implementation is unclear (switch in search UI, SQL join vs Lucene index). Performance of joining form entries also needs care.

title: Text einer Notiz in Dokument uebernehmen (wie Sprachmemo)
cause: The note viewer HtmlPanel (created in DocumentViewerFactory for .html) has no 'neues Dokument' action and gets no DocumentPreviewSaveCallback, unlike SoundplayerPanel.cmdNewDocumentActionPerformed(), which passes the transcript as ingoText to EditArchiveFileDetailsPanel.newDocumentDialog() for {{INGO_TEXT}}.
maintainer: Issue written by j-dimension: transfer note text without the header into documents, like the voice memo function.
notes: Behaviour defined by analogy with the existing voice memo button. Header = the table + <hr/> that AddNoteFrame prepends, so strip up to the first <hr> and convert HTML to plain text with paragraph breaks (Jsoup), which is a unit-testable helper. LibreOfficeAccess already handles multi-paragraph INGO_TEXT. Needs the .form update. iradraconis' context-menu/Ingo idea overlaps #2934 and should stay out of scope.

title: Aktenvorschlag anhand Aktenzeichen auch bei eEB-Abgabe
cause: BeaMessageContentUI.saveEebResponse() builds the SearchAndAssignDialog context from msgContainer reference fields plus response.getSubject()/getBody() of the eEB message returned by beAstie, not the subject/body of the incoming message, so a file number that is only in the original subject is never matched (the inbox save path in BeaInboxPanel uses m.getSubject()+m.getBody()).
notes: One-line fix: add msgContainer.getSubject()/getBody() to the context (could be extracted to a small static helper for a unit test). Caveats: SearchAndAssignDialog only matches against the 150 last-changed cases and lowercases the context but not getFileNumber(), so file numbers with capital letters never match (separate small bug affecting all callers). Only applies when the eEB is given from the inbox, from inside a case no dialog is shown.

title: Etikett ueber Desktop direkt entfernen koennen
cause: Desktop tagged entries (TaggedEntryPanelTransparent) only open the case on click, there is no context menu or action to remove a tag.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension with empty body.
notes: UI undecided: an entry can show several matching tags, case tags vs document tags (TaggedEntry.documentId), multi-value tags, confirmation and refresh of the Tagged panel. Would be close to F once a 'context menu per shown tag' design is agreed, Swing only and not headless-testable.

title: Wiedervorlagen kategorisieren
cause: ArchiveFileReviewsBean has eventType, summary, assignee, calendarSetup and reminder fields but no category.
notes: Needs a new column (schema change) or a product decision to reuse calendar entry templates or tags as categories, plus a batch-processing view for one category.

title: Handhabung von Dateien > 2GB
cause: Document content is passed around as byte[] (ServerFileUtils.readFile, getDocumentContent, addDocument), limited to Integer.MAX_VALUE. Only the DataBucket path (getDocumentContentBucket) streams in chunks.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension: a solution without the byte-array limit has to be designed.
notes: Architectural change across EJB API, client and storage. Related to openspec change add-document-encryption-at-rest (C5 DataBucket streaming path, explicitly notes the 2 GB cap).

title: Standardordner fuer Notizen
cause: AddNoteFrame.cmdAddDocumentActionPerformed() calls addDocument(caseId, name, bytes, "", null) without any folder, so new notes always land in the case root folder. No default-folder setting exists anywhere.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension: per-user or global setting for the folder of new notes.
notes: User vs global setting, folder resolution by name in each case tree and behaviour when the folder is missing (create or root) are undecided.

title: Erweiterte Sprecherbenennung bei Transkription
cause: SoundplayerPanel.processOutput() puts the transcript from the external Ingo backend verbatim into taTranscription, speaker labels like 'SPRECHER 1' are produced there and the client offers no rename or search/replace.
notes: Two variants proposed (suggest names from case parties vs simple search/replace). The label format is defined by the external Ingo service. A small 'Sprecher umbenennen' dialog would be feasible once a variant is chosen.

title: Multiwindow fuer Sprachmemo-Funktion
cause: AddVoiceMemoDialog is a modal JDialog (modal=true in ArchiveFilePanel.cmdAddVoiceMemoActionPerformed and SoundplayerPanel continue-recording), the caller reads getMemoBytes() synchronously after setVisible(), which blocks the case window while recording.
notes: Follow-up of #2940, where notes became the non-modal AddNoteFrame registered via EditorsRegistry.registerFrame. Same refactor needed here (dialog saves to the captured case itself). Open points: switching or closing the case while recording, the continue-recording path. M-sized Swing refactor, not headless-verifiable, so not F.

title: Messenger: Nachrichtenpriorisierung
cause: InstantMessage has no priority field (only sent, sender, content, case and document context, mentions).
notes: Needs a new DB column plus UI for selection, highlighting, filter and a separate tab.

title: Termin in mehrere Kalender eintragen
cause: ArchiveFileReviewsBean references exactly one CalendarSetup and the event dialogs offer a single calendar selection.
notes: Could be done client-side by creating one independent event per selected calendar, but linked vs independent copies, later edit/delete and cloud sync need a decision. Touches the area of openspec change add-bidirectional-nextcloud-calendar-sync.

title: Schlagworte / Notiz an Dokument (Rest: Kategorie/Dokumentart)
cause: All checklist items except 'Kategorie / Dokumentart' were delivered by 5bbc007de (title, keywords, received date, correspondent, parent hierarchy, list display, keyword suggestions). A category maintained in settings can already be modelled as a document multi-value tag (document.tags.mv.Dokumentart, multi-value tags since 225cd99c6).
maintainer: j-dimension updated the checklist on 2026-09-29 and left only the category item open.
notes: Mostly done. Remaining item needs a decision: close it in favour of document multi-value tags, or add a dedicated category field (schema change, X).

title: Messaging: Nachricht mit Referenzen auf mehrere Dokumente
cause: InstantMessage.documentContext is a single @ManyToOne on column document_id.
notes: Needs a new join table (Flyway migration), API changes and messenger UI changes.

title: Weitere Ingo-Funktionen bei Notizen
cause: AddNoteFrame and HtmlPanel only use Ingo transcription (REQUESTTYPE_TRANSCRIBE), while SendEmailFrame builds popAssistant via AssistantAccess.populateMenu for GENERATE, EXPLAIN, SUMMARIZE, TRANSLATE and CHAT.
notes: Mirroring the e-mail Ingo menu in the note editor (button, AssistantInputAdapter, result insertion) is feasible but M-sized with .form changes. The concrete prompts (Antworten, Briefkopf, DeepL) are server-side Ingo configuration. Scope and placement undecided. Overlaps the context-menu idea in #3258.

title: Ingo-Transkription auch fuer AAC und Opus
cause: The client decodes only MP3 and OGG Vorbis to WAV via javax.sound SPIs (AudioConvertUtils, PR #3624 merged as 679ca2fe9). AAC was dropped because the JAAD forks hijack all AudioSystem calls, Opus has no Java Sound provider at all.
maintainer: Prefers server-side conversion with ffmpeg on the WildFly host (precedent LibreOffice), alternative codec-only client libs called per file extension. Keeps the ticket open for AAC/Opus.
notes: New server-side system dependency or substantial own codec code, needs ffmpeg in the test environment. Not a small PR.

title: macOS: clicks in the document list often not recognised
cause: Likely cause: list-view selection runs in mouseClicked handlers (lblFileNameMouseClicked and siblings) on labels that also carry drag gesture recognizers. On macOS any pointer movement between press and release (Magic Mouse, sensitive mice) suppresses mouseClicked, so the click is lost. Handling selection on mousePressed or mouseReleased with a small tolerance would avoid it
notes: Only verifiable on macOS hardware (Linux works per commenter). The table view (CaseDocumentsTable, JTable selection on press) is a workaround. b8d672171 (2026-10-27) touched the same handler for the context menu

title: Akte loeschen nur nach Passworteingabe / geschuetzte Akten
cause: Case deletion (QuickArchiveFileSearchPanel -> ArchiveFileService.removeArchiveFile) only needs removeArchiveFileRole, group access and a yes/no confirmation dialog.
maintainer: Issue by j-dimension, optional idea: mark cases as protected and prevent deletion.
notes: Password re-entry vs protected flag is a product decision. A protected flag needs a new column (X). Password re-check must be enforced server-side to be meaningful.

title: Priorität für Kalendereinträge und Benachrichtigungen (Desktop)
cause: Desktop due list is sorted by type, day, time, case id in the comparator of ReviewsDueTimerTask (around line 859). Calendar entries have neither a priority nor a creation date column (ArchiveFileReviewsBean), so a priority sort key needs a new case_events column.
maintainer: Likes priorities as a simple secondary sort key within a day (instead of configurable multi-criteria sorting), also suggests an optional per-entry notification with prominent display or popup shortly before appointments.
notes: Needs schema change (priority column, plus REST, web, sync). The notification part is largely covered by event reminders (79b864dad, close #3285: reminder_minutes, ReminderNotificationDialog, archived openspec add-calendar-reminders).

title: KI-gestützter Import von Zeiten in Zeiterfassungsprojekt
cause: Issue body is empty. Ingo tool calling already offers get_open_timesheets_for_case and create_timesheet_position (ToolRegistry, added in 8d0af59c7 on 2026-03-10), so a list of times pasted into the Ingo chat can already be turned into timesheet positions.
maintainer: Opened by j-dimension without any description.
notes: Scope undefined (dedicated import dialog vs. chat). Probably obsolete through the Ingo timesheet tools, maintainer should confirm and close or specify what is missing.

title: Abwesenheiten im Datumsauswahl-Popup hervorheben
cause: MultiCalDialog shows three plain com.toedter JDayChooser instances (jcalendar 1.3.2, which has no IDateEvaluator), days are never decorated. Conflicts with absences are only detected after saving via CalendarUtils.checkForConflicts (#1274).
maintainer: Confirmed with the reporter that this is about the small date selection popup.
notes: Needs decisions: whose entries (current user vs. selected assignee, the popup is used in about 28 places without that context), which entries count as absence, colours, hover tooltips, extra server query per 3-month range. Overlaps #299 (holiday colouring in the same popup), a shared day-decoration mechanism would serve both.

title: Erweiterungen Aktenanlageassistent (Dokument direkt zuordnen)
cause: Five of six checklist items are done (65698fcd3, 7b71d5dc8 and later wizard work). The remaining item is open: the wizard (CreateNewCasePanel.cmdNewCaseActionPerformed, ConfirmationStep.display) creates case, parties and calendar entry but never stores the source e-mail (or the scan, ScannerPanel.openCreateCaseWizard) in the new case.
maintainer: Checklist written by j-dimension, the last open item is 'Dokument zuordnen direkt bei Anlageassistent'.
notes: Open questions: save as .eml or with separate attachments, name template, folder, document tags, behaviour for the scanner source. Would duplicate SaveToCasePanel logic unless refactored. Not a tiny PR.

title: Backup restore fails on MariaDB with utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci collation
cause: RestoreExecutor.restoreDatabase sources jlawyerdb-dump.sql unchanged via the mysql CLI. Dumps from MySQL 8 carry utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci for tables created with only DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4, which older MariaDB rejects. Add a streaming rewrite of utf8mb4_0900_* to utf8mb4_unicode_ci (only when the target reports MariaDB) before sourcing the dump
maintainer: Fix either by avoiding such collations or by replacing them in the backup manager, e.g. sed s/utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci/utf8mb4_unicode_ci/g on the dump
notes: Replacement helper is unit-testable. Avoiding the collation would need migrations (X). Newer MariaDB releases (10.11.11, 11.4.5 and later, to be verified) accept utf8mb4_0900_* as aliases, which lowers urgency. Dump can be large, so stream instead of reading into memory

title: WildFly log cleanup does not work (logs grow without limit)
cause: 20b29d392 (2023-11-29) replaced the size-rotating-file-handler with max-backup-index 20 by a periodic-rotating-file-handler without any backup limit in docker/wildfly/standalone.xml, so daily server.log files are never pruned. The same file sets org.wildfly.security to TRACE, which inflates the logs
maintainer: Own note: try size-rotating-file-handler with rotate-size 100m and max-backup-index 5 for server.log and access_log
notes: Only the Docker config is in this repo. The installer standalone.xml lives elsewhere and existing installs are not updated. Needs a running WildFly to verify. A docker-only config PR would be S if the maintainer wants it

title: Scans automatisch zuordnen (OCR, verakten und taggen)
cause: Not implemented. Automatic mail filing lives server-side in MailboxScannerTask.processMailboxViaService (file number in subject/body, sender, CC, TO, default case). Scans only get manual case suggestions in ScannerPanel.loadCaseSuggestionsAsync (text-based file number match).
maintainer: Opened by j-dimension: analogous to the automatic assignment of mails.
notes: Large server feature with configuration (enable flag, tags, ambiguity handling, OCR timing, see sequential OCR fix f74f50d9e). Automatically moving files out of the scan inbox is risky.

title: Geburtstage als Wiedervorlage
cause: Not implemented. AddressBean stores a birth date, but nothing creates birthday reminders and the desktop shows no birthdays.
notes: A per-contact option needs a new address column (schema, X). Follow-ups are always bound to a case (archiveFileKey), so a yearly birthday follow-up needs a design decision (which case, recurrence). A desktop birthday widget without schema would be an alternative.

title: Sortierung beA-Nachricht vs. eEB-Abgabe innerhalb der Akte
cause: Not located. The bulk save path sets the message document date to the reception time (BeaInboxPanel, bulkEntry.setDocumentDate(m.getReceptionTime()) since 5f48b1b76) and saveEebResponse() stores the eEB with the current time, CaseFolderPanel sorts by the full creation timestamp, so the chronological order should already be correct.
notes: Old report (2024) against the previous document list UI, which has since been replaced (5bbc007de). Need the exact import path and timestamps from the reporter, or a re-test on current master. Expected order is not fully specified.

title: Case header without line wrap pushes buttons off screen on laptops
cause: In ArchiveFilePanel.initComponents lblHeaderInfo (file number + Kurzrubrum + wegen) is added to the horizontal group with default sizes, so its minimum width equals the full text width and forces the whole panel wider than the window. Set min size 0 in the .form/.java (JLabel then truncates with an ellipsis) and put the full text in a tooltip, or wrap via HTML
notes: Duplicate of #1323 (same cause, one PR closes both). Editor pane is no longer a scroll pane, so the overflow is clipped. Must keep the .form in sync for the NetBeans GUI builder

title: New case: lawyer, assistant and subject field lost after next new case
cause: Not confirmed. The three fields are exactly those clearInputs() resets (cmbLawyer, cmbAssistant, cmbSubjectField). Suspect path: confirmSave() keeps the saved case in the singleton NewArchiveFilePanel (setArchiveFileDTO), and re-selecting New Case returns early in EditorsRegistry.setMainEditorsPaneView (same component, no reset), so later edits and saves can hit the saved case
notes: Exact click sequence and version unknown (2024), no maintainer reply. Needs a reproducible sequence before a fix

title: Dokumenterstellen-Dialog für kleine Bildschirme optimieren
cause: Layout problem on low resolutions (screenshot only). Since then 388d4f43c (2024-11-28, issue #2689) replaced the vertical split of placeholders and parties with tabs, and the dialog sizes itself via FrameUtils.fitDialogToScreen(this, 85f).
maintainer: Mitigated by shortening role names, low priority. Other dialogs need their own ticket including the horizontal resolution.
notes: Original screenshot not reviewable here. Likely improved by the 2024-11 tab layout, needs a re-check by the reporter on the current version with the screen resolution before any change. Swing layout is not headless verifiable.

title: Logo and wordmark on splash/login look blurry
cause: LoginDialog shows /images/j-lawyer-logo-125px.png (125x102 raster), which gets upscaled and blurred under OS display scaling. Needs a higher-resolution or vector asset (multi-resolution image or SVG icon)
notes: Cosmetic, depends on a design asset from the project, not a code bug

title: No scrolling of the folder list while dragging documents into folders
cause: Each FolderListCell registers its own DropTarget with an empty dragOver() and neither the cells nor FoldersListPanel implement java.awt.dnd.Autoscroll. Native DnD swallows mouse wheel events on Windows/Linux, so folders outside the viewport are unreachable. Implement edge autoscroll (Autoscroll interface or dragOver near the viewport edge calling scrollRectToVisible)
notes: Commenter proposes auto-scroll at the top/bottom edge, works already on macOS. Scroll-step logic can live in a small testable helper, manual check on Linux/Windows. Same file as the already covered FolderListCell.drop() fix, sequence the PRs. Related to #2781

title: Messaging area lacks a heading
cause: Unclear which view the screenshot shows. MessagingCenterPanel has had the title Nachrichten since its first version f18b2f740 (2023-09-19), so it is likely another messaging area (case tab or desktop)
notes: Labelled question, cosmetic, location and expected heading unclear without the screenshot

title: Contacts: encryption label at top right touches the window edge
cause: The top-level horizontal group in AddressPanel.initComponents only has a leading addContainerGap() and no trailing gap (the .form lacks the closing EmptySpace), so jPanel23 with chkEncryption/lblEncryption and the tab pane run flush to the right edge. ArchiveFilePanel has the trailing gap
maintainer: Asked whether OS scaling is used (reporter: 105 percent on Windows 10)
notes: One EmptySpace in the .form plus addContainerGap() in the generated code. Cosmetic but trivially reviewable

title: Automatische Dokumentetiketten pro Nutzer
cause: Automatic tagging exists only as DocumentTagRule, whose conditions match the document name (ArchiveFileService around line 2339). There is no condition on the acting user.
maintainer: A list of relevant actions must be defined first, some actions (convert to PDF, extract a mail attachment) must not trigger the automatic tag.
notes: Needs a product definition of the triggering actions. A user condition in tag rules probably needs a new condition attribute (schema). Not F.

title: Server does not listen on IPv6
cause: WildFly is started with -Djava.net.preferIPv4Stack=true (WildFly default and docker/wildfly/standalone.conf), so all sockets bind to 0.0.0.0 only. This is installer/runtime configuration, not j-lawyer code
notes: Installer configs are not in this repo, needs an IPv6 or dual-stack environment to verify. Client launchers also force preferIPv4Stack (related #1881)

title: Gruppe als Verantwortliche für WV oder Termin
cause: The assignee is a single user name string (ArchiveFileReviewsBean.assignee). Group assignment needs a new column or encoding plus changes to desktop filters, conflict checks, notifications, Nextcloud sync, REST and web.
notes: Cross-cutting data model change, not a small PR.

title: RAM monitor counts page cache as used, constant warnings on Linux
cause: SystemMonitorTask.getPhysicalMemStatusLevel and SystemManagement.getMonitoringSnapshot use OperatingSystemMXBean.getFreePhysicalMemorySize(), which on Linux returns MemFree (sysinfo freeram) and so counts buffers/cache as used. Read MemAvailable from /proc/meminfo on Linux (fallback to the MXBean) in one shared helper
maintainer: RAM check can be disabled. An external library apparently counts buffered RAM as used (it is actually the JDK MXBean)
notes: Code unchanged since the initial commit 674bb3ade. Parsing /proc/meminfo is unit-testable. The two duplicated calculations should share the helper

title: Bidirektionale Kalendersynchronisation (Nextcloud)
cause: CalendarSyncService only pushes entries to Nextcloud, NextcloudCalendarConnector.getAllEvents() exists but is unused.
maintainer: Detailed ctag/etag/href sync plan in the issue body (2023-11-07), users offered sponsoring.
notes: Active openspec change add-bidirectional-nextcloud-calendar-sync (d2fc89478, 0 of 38 tasks done) targets exactly this. Needs schema (etag, href, last-modified per entry). Large.

title: beA: Anzeigenamen von Gerichtsdokumenten werden nicht angezeigt
cause: Old client-side beA wrapper only got the alias after the message had been decrypted in beA web. Since the beAstie migration (e43b2b0e8) BeaService.parseAttachmentList() reads the alias from beAstie and BeaAttachment.toString() displays it.
notes: Obsolete with beAstie, the same reporter confirms in #3424 (2026-06) that aliases are displayed now (even too prominently). Closing should reference #3424, which restores "(alias) filename".

title: beA: Notare finden - beN integrieren
cause: Identity search is fully delegated to beAstie (POST /api/v1/identities/search via BeaService.searchIdentity), so whether notaries (beN postboxes) are found depends on the BRAK/beAstie search, not on client logic. IdentityPanel already handles null fields via StringUtils.nonEmpty.
notes: Reporter suspects a BRAK interface limitation. Verifying search and sending to beN needs live beA and a notary postbox. Old report (2022, pre-beAstie), worth a re-test.

title: beA: eEB-Anforderung nach Abgabe unveraendert angezeigt
cause: The eEB-done state only lives in the in-memory flag BeaMessageContentUI.eebSubmitted (reset per displayed message), lblEeb is driven by msg.isEebRequested() from beAstie, there is no persisted answered state.
maintainer: j-dimension: the BRAK interface has no service to query this status, only a local mailbox image would help, which is a lot of work.
notes: Needs a design decision on where to persist the answered state (DB, tag, document metadata) or a beAstie feature. Not a small PR.

title: Calendar: case changes (Rubrum) not pushed to Nextcloud events
cause: CalendarSyncService.getEventSummary/getEventDescription embed file number, name, reason and lawyer of the case, but ArchiveFileService.updateArchiveFile never calls calendarSync.eventUpdated for the open events (it only fires CaseUpdatedEvent, observed solely by CustomHooksService). Only the optional twice-daily full sync would refresh them
notes: Fix: inject CalendarSyncServiceLocal and push open reviews when these fields changed (capture old values before edit). Change-detection helper unit-testable, end-to-end check needs a Nextcloud (Docker). Touches the same service as openspec add-bidirectional-nextcloud-calendar-sync, which does not cover this case

title: beA: Laufzettel Umlaute falsch dargestellt
cause: Classic UTF-8 read as ISO-8859-1 (ausgefÃ¼hrt) in the OSCI feedback text. Since the beAstie migration the process card (osciMessage, entries[].text) arrives as JSON via HttpClient BodyHandlers.ofString() (UTF-8 default) and is shown unchanged, so the mis-decoding, if still present, happens inside beAstie or upstream.
maintainer: j-dimension: same cause as #1003, sample received by e-mail, blocked by lack of time.
notes: Report predates beAstie (2021), needs a re-test with a German EGVP Laufzettel against live beA. No client/server decoding step found in this repo.

title: beA: Ordner "in Akte importiert" fehlt in "gesendet"
cause: BeaAccess.getFolderStructure() creates/caches exactly one imported folder per postbox under the inbox, and the save-to-case code in BeaInboxPanel always moves to BeaAccess.getImportedFolder(), so a message from Gesendet is moved across top-level folders, which BRAK rejects.
maintainer: j-dimension: sent messages are usually stored in the case automatically anyway (questions the need).
notes: Options: skip the move when the source is not under the inbox (minimal) or create an imported subfolder per top-level folder (reporter wish). Choice needs maintainer decision and verification needs live beA.

title: Long Kurzrubrum/wegen widens the case editor, labels unreachable
cause: Same as #2448: lblHeaderInfo has minimum width = text width in the ArchiveFilePanel GroupLayout, so the panel grows beyond the screen and tags/buttons are cut off without a scrollbar
notes: Duplicate of #2448 (older report). Fix both in one PR (min size 0 plus tooltip or wrapping)

title: Fristen / WV mit wählbarem Vorlauf auf dem Desktop anzeigen
cause: 106027841 (2025-10-24, close #3010) added days into the future to the Fällig widget, fb507da60 (2026-08-21, #3555) made the past and future window configurable per type (Termine, Fristen, Wiedervorlagen) with 0, 1, 3, 7, 14, 31 days ahead, persisted in user settings via DueDaysSettings.
maintainer: The off-topic desktop layout question belongs in a separate ticket.
notes: Matches the request exactly, including separate lead times for Fristen and WV. Can be closed with reference to #3010 and #3555.

title: Owner group and permissions can be overwritten from a stale open case
cause: Owner-only editing of group and allowed groups is enforced only in the client at load time (ArchiveFileDetailLoadAction sets tblGroups/cmbGroups enabled). updateArchiveFile and updateAllowedGroups only call SecurityUtils.checkGroupsForCase, which accepts owner OR allowed groups, so a user with an outdated view can save the old group/permissions
maintainer: Scenario 5 is a bug: on save the server must check whether the user may still change it. Without an owner group there is intentionally no access protection, docs should say so
notes: Only scenario 5 is a code bug, the rest is documentation or by design. Add an owner check (owner group null or caller member) when group or allowed groups change, mirroring the client rule. Security sensitive, check REST v1/v2 and BulkEditCasePermissions paths

title: DSGVO Löschplan
cause: Not implemented. ArchiveFileBean already has date_archived, so finding cases archived longer than X months is possible without schema changes.
maintainer: A first step could be a dialog listing all cases archived longer than x months for deletion, optionally with automatic removal of contacts only involved in those cases. Full deletion plans judged too costly for their value. Linked to #221.
notes: Mass deletion of cases and contacts is high risk and needs decisions (retention 6 vs 10 years, delete vs tag or archive, contact cleanup rules, no automatic deletion per community). Not a small PR.

title: Übersicht über verwendete Dokumentetiketten
cause: The case-level overview is still only an HTML tooltip on the document tag filter button (ArchiveFilePanel.updateDocumentTagsOverview, TagUtils.getDocumentTagsOverviewAsHtml). Since 5bbc007de (2026-09-26) the active tags are shown on every document (chips in the list view, Etiketten column in the table view).
maintainer: Should be visible at a glance again, layout still unclear.
notes: Layout decision open. The per-document tag chips from add-document-metadata-and-views may already satisfy the at-a-glance goal, maintainer could close. Small once a layout is chosen.

title: Documents: inconsistent context menu actions on multi-selection
cause: Partly fixed: copy/move to another case now handles all selected documents. Still open: mnuRenameDocumentActionPerformed silently returns when more than one document is selected and mnuOpenDocumentActionPerformed opens only get(0), while showDocumentsPopup never disables these single-document items for multi-selection
notes: Minimal fix: in showDocumentsPopup enable rename/open only for a single selection (keeping the readOnly/archived rule from setReadOnly). Opening all selected is a UX choice, disabling is the safe option

title: beA: Fehler nach Versand einer Nachricht mit ca. 7 MB
cause: Not located. Report from 1.13 (2020) concerns the old client-side beA wrapper, which was replaced by the server-side beAstie integration in e43b2b0e8, the error text is only in a screenshot.
notes: Very likely obsolete, suggest asking the reporter to re-test on 3.x and close. No reproducible info.

title: beA: Nachrichtenfenster verzoegert beim Wechsel der Nachrichten
cause: 555e02712 (2025-11-13) added BeaInboxPanel.displayMessage(): the content pane is cleared immediately on click/arrow key, loading is debounced (200 ms) and done in a SwingWorker with getMessageWithoutAttachments (attachments lazy). Earlier attempt ba33ed70c (2020).
maintainer: j-dimension asked whether #1406 improved it, reporter said yes but still noticeable with many attachments.
notes: The requested behaviour (empty pane right after selecting another message) is implemented, the remaining spinner wish is cosmetic. Can be closed.

title: beA: eEB-Anzeige fehlerhaft / leer
cause: A returning eEB (zuruecklaufend) only references the request via XJustiz message ids, BeaMessageContentUI.cmdEebShowActionPerformed renders getEebAsHtml(null, xml) without the matching request (TODO comment references #917), so case and document info are missing.
maintainer: j-dimension: BRAK confirmed the link exists only in the encrypted SDS, a KSW must store or search the whole mailbox to find the request, not feasible for now.
notes: Needs a design for locating the request (local message store or searching saved .bea documents by Nachrichten-ID), effectively a large feature. Possibly related to #3384.

title: beA: Reihenfolge aendern fuehrt zu Alias-Aenderung
cause: SendBeaMessageFrame.updateAlias() regenerates every alias as NN_Schriftsatz/Anlage_ + text after the last underscore and falls back to the file name when the user removed all underscores, so a free alias like Test is replaced on every reorder/checkbox change.
maintainer: j-dimension: alias generation is intended (court wish for numbering per ERVV), text after the prefix is preserved, unclear whether anything should change.
notes: Reporters want a free alias without automatism. Changing the generation rules is a product decision. 1339b606d (2020) only preserved the suffix.

title: Fristen / Wiedervorlagen an Dokumente koppeln
cause: Not on master, case_events has no document reference. An implementation exists on the unmerged upstream branch feat/mentionsDocumentsInDueDate (41dc62c62 plus 2 commits, 2025-09, Maximilian Steinert) with migration V3_4_0_8__EventsDocumentContext.sql.
notes: Schema change. The branch migration version V3_4_0_8 clashes with master's V3_4_0_8__TimesheetsNameIncrease.sql, so the branch needs renumbering and a rebase by its author. The 2025-09-11 comment by iradraconis shows that branch.

title: Adressen: Export als vCard
cause: Not implemented in the desktop client. Only vCard import (ImportContactsDialog) and CardDAV push (NextcloudContactsConnector.getVCard, private, works on CloudContact) exist. ez-vcard is already a client dependency.
maintainer: Opened by j-dimension, labelled good first issue and hacktoberfest-accepted, links the docs topic on exporting addresses.
notes: Suggested PR: new client helper mapping AddressBean to an ezvcard VCard (unit-testable, mirror the CardDAV mapping incl. EMAIL PREF from the contact-emails spec) plus an 'Als vCard exportieren' item in popupAddressActions that writes one .vcf for the selected contacts. Needs .form update. No schema.

title: Feiertage im Datumsauswahl-Kalender farblich absetzen
cause: MultiCalDialog uses plain JDayChooser (jcalendar 1.3.2). Holidays are only checked after the click in selectDate (warning dialog), never rendered. Holidays per year are available via CalendarServiceRemote.getAllHolidays(year, country, region) with the current user's country and area code (UserSettings.getCurrentUser()).
notes: Suggested PR: JDayChooser subclass that recolours holiday day buttons after drawDays() (verify protected API of jcalendar 1.3.2) with the holiday name as tooltip, per-year holiday cache in CalendarUtils (unit-testable), swap the three choosers in MultiCalDialog and its .form. Not endorsed by the maintainer yet and overlaps #2736 (absences in the same popup), so ask j-dimension whether holidays alone are welcome. Reporter wanted it at least optional.

title: Aktensuche - Etikettenfilter Mehrfachauswahl
cause: 657b9dc65 (2025-09-12, #1050) switched the tag filter popups built by TagUtils.populateTags (used by QuickArchiveFileSearchPanel for case and document tags) to StayOpenCheckBoxMenuItem, so several tags can be selected or deselected without reopening the popup.
notes: Core complaint solved. The proposed extra buttons (clear, OK, cancel, edit tags) do not exist but were only a suggested means. Can be closed, effectively a duplicate of #1050.

title: Unterstützung mehrerer Aktenkreise (Nummernbereiche)
cause: Only one numbering scheme exists (ServerSettingsKeys.SERVERCONF_CASENUMBERING_PATTERN, CaseNumberGenerator). There is no concept of several number ranges or of choosing one at case creation.
maintainer: Reformulated: several case ranges with different schemes or the same scheme with a different minimum counter, selection mandatory at case creation once more than one range exists.
notes: Large feature touching numbering, case creation in client, wizard, REST and web, likely new configuration storage.

title: Massenänderungen an Akten (z.B. Anwalt wechseln)
cause: Not implemented. The case search popup has bulk actions (duplicate, delete, sync on or off, permissions via BulkEditCasePermissions from 4f3378121, #3203) but none to change lawyer or assistant on several cases, nor to reassign calendar entries in bulk.
maintainer: Asks which other bulk changes come into question (scope open).
notes: A 'change lawyer or assistant for selected cases' action modelled on BulkEditCasePermissions would be a contained M-size PR, but the scope (which fields, also reassigning open calendar entries as asked in the comment) needs maintainer agreement first.

title: Startseite/Übersichtsseite für HTML-Exporte
cause: The scheduled HTML export in IterativeBackupTask (export location of the backup job) writes one folder per case plus wiedervorlagen-fristen.csv but no root index. Only the manual batch export ArchiveFileService.loadHtmlCaseExport (7e32e930d, f2c459b08, #3108 and #3109) writes a root index.html, in input order and without HTML escaping of case names.
maintainer: Taken as 'maybe' for an upcoming version (2019).
notes: Suggested PR: extract the root index writer into AdvancedHtmlExport (static, HTML-escaped, unit-testable) and call it at the end of the IterativeBackupTask export loop with cases sorted by last change (getLastChangedForArchiveFile is already computed there), plus a second page sorted by file number. Already partly addressed for the manual batch export.

title: Archivierung: Archivnummer und/oder Aktenstandort
cause: Not implemented. ArchiveFileBean has date_archived but no archive number, storage location or archive note.
maintainer: Data model extension planned: archive number (running number plus year), archive date, location, archive note, searchable by archive date, to be done together with #332. Workaround: archive number generator in the calculations plus a renamed custom case field.
notes: Schema change plus numbering logic and UI. The archive confirmation idea from the comments is a separate topic.
